results.title: The Rise of Indian MMPs in a Market Dominated by Global Players
results.description: Local measurement firms are winning ground as India's app economy tops 25 billion downloads, forcing global MMPs to adapt to faster, cheaper rivals.

results.title: Building SaaS for deskless workers: designing systems that work under real operational pressure
results.description: For deskless staff, shorter app use can signal success because the software is meant to fit around interrupted work, not interrupt it.

results.title: JEE Main 2027: NTA Opens Application Correction Window; Check Which Details Can Be Edited
results.description: JEE Main 2027: Candidates who have registered for the examination can make changes to permitted details in their online application forms from November 27 to November 29, 2026.
